intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: At RecruitSpace, we take our users' privacy very seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.text: We collect information you provide directly when using our services:
dataCollected.item1: Identification data: name, surname and email address
dataCollected.item2: Contact data: phone number and postal address
dataCollected.item3: Professional data: resume, work experience and education
dataCollected.item4: Usage data: information about how you interact with our platform

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.text: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
purpose.item1: Manage your account and provide our services
purpose.item2: Facilitate your participation in selection processes
purpose.item3: Send you communications related to relevant job offers

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: As a user, you have the following rights over your personal data:
rights.item1: Right of access: you can request a copy of your personal data
rights.item2: Right of rectification: you can correct inaccurate or incomplete data
rights.item3: Right of erasure: you can request the deletion of your data
rights.item4: Right of portability: you can request your data in a structured format

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us at support@recruitspace.com

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.text: By accessing or using RecruitSpace, you agree to be bound by these terms of use. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you should not use our platform.

service.title: Service description
service.text: RecruitSpace is a recruitment process management platform that connects candidates with companies. We provide tools to post job offers, manage applications and facilitate communication between parties.

obligations.title: User obligations
obligations.text: As a RecruitSpace user, you agree to:
obligations.item2: Maintain the confidentiality of your access credentials
obligations.item3: Use the platform only for legitimate job search or recruitment purposes
obligations.item4: Respect the intellectual property rights of third parties

intellectual.title: Intellectual property
intellectual.text: All RecruitSpace content, including texts, graphics, logos, icons and images, is the property of RecruitSpace or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws.

limitation.title: Limitation of liability
limitation.text: RecruitSpace does not guarantee employment or success in selection processes. Our liability is limited to the operation of the platform as described in these terms.

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be notified through the platform and will take effect upon publication.

what.title: What are cookies
what.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They allow us to remember your preferences and improve your user experience.

types.title: Types of cookies we use
types.text: At RecruitSpace we use the following types of cookies:

essential.name: Essential cookies
essential.desc: Necessary for the basic operation of the platform, such as authentication and security.

functional.name: Functional cookies
functional.desc: Allow us to remember your preferences, such as your selected language.

analytics.name: Analytics cookies
analytics.desc: Help us understand how users interact with the platform to improve it.

manage.title: Cookie management
manage.text: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling some cookies may affect the operation of the platform.

thirdParty.title: Third-party cookies
thirdParty.text: Some of our service providers may use their own cookies. These cookies are subject to the privacy policies of those third parties.
